svg.title: A little world in progress
svg.desc: An imagined island takes shape from wireframe into a tiny landscape. An explorer walks along the path, jumps to reach a star, and returns to the beginning. At each catch, a colored Builder, Thinker, Dreamer, or Leader briefly overlays Anshul while the name remains faintly visible. Below the name, Blender, Claude Code, Chrome, VS Code, Roblox Studio, Codex, and GitHub exchange through curved strands. Shared letters remain while changed letters flip on small split-flap panels. A tiny star drifts below each name.
